text.description: Kinetic typography (pop | stagger | slam | type), auto-fit to the frame; emphasis words in the accent colour.
text.pickWhen: punchlines, titles, end cards, one-word reactions ("DEPLOYED.")

window.description: Technical UI window: AI chat (typing dots, streaming), terminal, error dialog, or a notification toast.
window.pickWhen: show what a character reads/types; notifications that escalate the plot; make screen text readable on phones

callout.description: Arrow + label pinned to a 3D target (item.anchor, actor[.anchor], mark or point); follows it through camera moves.
callout.pickWhen: point out a key, a prop or a character the viewer must notice

impact.description: Seeded burst of shards, dust puff and a ground ring at a 3D point.
impact.pickWhen: landings, slams, something hitting something (pair with shake + a sound)

glitch.description: Chromatic-aberration glitch burst on the 3D image.

flash.description: Brief full-frame flash (default white) fading out.
flash.pickWhen: hard hits, camera-flash gags, covering a smash cut

dip.description: Dip to a colour and back (fully covered at the middle — put the cut there).
dip.pickWhen: time skips, endings, softening a big location change
